en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put one into your
inkwell facedown and exerted, one on the top of your
deck, and one on the bottom of your deck.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。將一張牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池，一張放到牌庫頂，一張放到牌庫底。

name: Intense Research
en:
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, then put one into
your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck
in any order. If you removed an ink drop to play this
action, look at the top 5 cards of your deck instead.
zh: 查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡，然後將一張加入手牌，其餘的以任意順序放到牌庫底。若你移除過墨滴來打出這個行動，改為查看你牌庫頂 5 張卡。

name: Scram!
en:
Put chosen opposing character with cost 2 or less into
their player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 將一個費用 2 或以下的指定對方角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Blinding Chem Ball
en:
DESTABILIZE ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Banish this item.
BRILLIANT BURST During your turn, when this item is
banished, you may get 1 ink drop. If you do, chosen
character gets -2 ¤ this turn. (You may remove an ink
drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
失穩　⟳，2 ⬡ — 消滅這個物品。
耀眼爆裂　在你的回合中，當這個物品被消滅時，你可以獲得 1 個墨滴。若你這麼做，指定角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Prototype Chem Ball
en:
DESTABILIZE ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Banish this item.
ENIGMA BURST During your turn, when this item is
banished, you may get 1 ink drop. If you do, chosen
character of yours gains Resist +1 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1. You
may remove an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
失穩　⟳，2 ⬡ — 消滅這個物品。
謎團爆裂　在你的回合中，當這個物品被消滅時，你可以獲得 1 個墨滴。若你這麼做，你一個指定角色獲得抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Spyglass Hat
en:
HAT COUTURE Whenever you play this or another item,
if the item you played has a different name than each
other item you have in play, you may put a card from
your hand into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 帽飾時尚　每當你打出這個或另一個物品時，若該物品與你在場的每個其他物品名稱都不同，你可以將一張手牌牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Upgraded Chem Purse
en:
IT'S GOT POCKETS! ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish one of your other
items — Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal an item card and put it into your hand. Put the
rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh: 它有口袋！　⟳，1 ⬡，消滅你另一個物品 — 查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張物品卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Institute of Technology - Honey Lemon's Lab
en:
BREAK TIME Once during your turn, whenever a Super character quests
while here, return an item card from your discard to your hand.
zh: 休息時間　你回合中一次，每當一個超級角色在這裡探險時，將一張物品卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。

name: Flash - Efficient Clerk
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
TAKE...YOUR...TIME All characters lose Rush
and can't gain Rush.
zh:
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）
慢……慢……來　所有角色失去突襲，且不能獲得突襲。

name: Arthur - Merlin's Assistant
en:
MAGICAL TRAVEL When you play this character, you
may move him to a location for free.
ARCANE DELIVERIES Once during your turn, whenever
this character moves to a location, get 1 ink drop. (You
may remove an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
魔法旅行　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將他免費移動到一個地點。
奧術配送　你回合中一次，每當這個角色移動到一個地點時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Edgar Balthazar - Long-Suffering Butler
en:
TRUSTY UMBRELLA While this character has no
damage, he gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 2.)
zh: 可靠雨傘　當這個角色沒有傷害時，他獲得抵抗 +2。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Tiana - Restauranteur
en:
HANDPICKED When you play this character, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
zh: 精心挑選　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Raya - Determined Explorer
en:
TO THE ENDS OF THE REALM This character gets
+1 ◊ for each location you have in play.
zh: 直到王國盡頭　你每有一個地點在場，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Woolter & Jesse - Bellwether's Henchmen
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Napoleon - Patient Watchdog
en:
Alert (This character can challenge as if they had
Evasive.)
zh: 警戒（這個角色可以如同具有迴避般進行挑戰。）

name: Wildcat - Unconventional Mechanic
en:
WELL, THAT'S BROKEN When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item.
zh: 嗯，這壞了　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定物品。

name: Sir Kay - Determined to Win
en:
COMPETITIVE EDGE While you have an ink drop,
this character gains Challenger +3. (They get
+3 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 競爭優勢　當你有墨滴時，這個角色獲得挑戰者 +3。（他們挑戰時獲得 +3 ¤。）

name: Toulouse - Rough and Tumble
en:
UNBECOMING BEHAVIOR When you play this
character, opponents can't play actions until the
start of your next turn.
zh: 不得體的行為　當你打出這個角色時，對手不能打出行動，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Chief Bogo - Police Commissioner
en:
I KNOW THESE STREETS Whenever this character
quests, you may move him to a Hyperia City
location for free.
STOP RIGHT THERE 6 ⬡ — Chosen opposing
character can't challenge until the start of your
next turn.
zh:
我熟悉這些街道　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將他免費移動到一個 Hyperia City 地點。
站住　6 ⬡ — 指定的對方角色不能挑戰，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Sir Pellinore - Tougher Than He Looks
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
SPOILS OF VICTORY During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink
drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）
勝利戰利品　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Arthur - Novice Blacksmith
en:
CAREFUL CRAFTING When you play this character,
you may pay 1 ⬡ to get 1 ink drop. (You may remove
an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 細心製作　當你打出這個角色時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 來獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Berlioz - Tiny Rascal
en:
SHARP LITTLE CLAWS When you play this character,
you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
zh: 鋒利小爪　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Marie - Caught in the Act
en:
A LITTLE TREAT Whenever this character quests,
if an opposing character took damage this turn,
get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to
pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 小小獎勵　每當這個角色探險時，若有對方角色本回合受到過傷害，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Baloo - Delivery Pilot
en:
PAYMENT UP FRONT This character can't quest or
challenge unless you got an ink drop this turn.
zh: 預先付款　除非你本回合獲得過墨滴，否則這個角色不能探險或挑戰。

name: Sir Ector - Blustery Knight
en:
WELL DESERVED During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, draw a card.
zh: 實至名歸　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，抽一張牌。

name: Baloo - Freight Pilot
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh: 抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Kit Cloudkicker - Sure Shot
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Kit Cloudkicker.)
AERIAL ACROBATICS Whenever this character quests,
choose one:
• Get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to
pay 1 ⬡.)
• Deal 1 damage to chosen character.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Kit Cloudkicker 的角色上。）
空中技巧　每當這個角色探險時，選擇一項：
• 獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）
• 對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Arthur - Jousting Knight
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Arthur.)
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
VICTORY PURSE During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, draw a card and
get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Arthur 的角色上。）
挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）
勝利獎金　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，抽一張牌並獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Mr. Big - Distribution Magnate
en:
ICE OUT At the end of your turn, if all cards in your
inkwell are exerted, chosen opposing character
can't challenge until the start of your next turn.
zh: 冷凍出局　在你的回合結束時，若你墨水池中的所有卡都已橫置，指定的對方角色不能挑戰，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Shere Khan - Khan Industries CEO
en:
NEW INCENTIVE When you play this character, chosen
character can challenge ready characters this turn.
CORNER THE MARKET Once during your turn, whenever
one of your other characters banishes another character
in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink
drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
新獎勵　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合可以挑戰已準備的角色。
壟斷市場　你回合中一次，每當你另一個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Tiana - Party Hostess
en:
Shift 5 ⬡ (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Tiana.)
IDEAL VENUE When you play this character, you
may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a
card. If you discarded a location card this way,
you may play it from your discard for free.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Tiana 的角色上。）
理想場地　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽 2 張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。若你以此方式棄掉地點卡，你可以從棄牌堆免費打出它。

name: Jousting Match
en:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. If you removed an
ink drop to play this action, deal 5 damage instead.
zh: 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。若你移除過墨滴來打出這個行動，改為造成 5 點傷害。

name: Ink Explosion
en:
Deal 4 damage to chosen character. Get 1 ink drop.
(You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 對指定角色造成 4 點傷害。獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Khan Transport Delivery
en:
Draw a card. Get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink
drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 抽一張牌。獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: People Gonna Come Here
en:
(A character with cost 7 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Play a location from your hand or discard for free. If a
character sang this song, you may move them to that
location for free.
zh:
（費用 7 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
從你的手牌或棄牌堆免費打出一個地點。若有角色詠唱這首歌，你可以將他們免費移動到該地點。

name: Hyperia City Express
en:
EASY COMMUTE ⟳ — Move a character of yours to a
location for free.
STYLISH CONVENIENCE Your Hyperia City locations
get +2 ⛉.
zh:
輕鬆通勤　⟳ — 將你一個角色免費移動到一個地點。
時尚便利　你的 Hyperia City 地點獲得 +2 ⛉。

name: Pirate Plane
en:
DODGE THIS! When you play this item, you may deal 1
damage to chosen character.
BARREL ROLL ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gains Alert
this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
zh:
躲開這招！　當你打出這個物品時，你可以對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。
桶滾　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定角色本回合獲得警戒。（他們可以如同具有迴避般進行挑戰。）

name: Central Station - Transportation Hub
en:
FREE SOUVENIR Once during your turn, whenever a character moves
here, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 免費紀念品　你回合中一次，每當有角色移動到這裡時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Khan Industries - Greenway Landmark
en: HIGH SECURITY Characters can't be challenged while here.
zh: 高度戒備　角色在這裡時不能被挑戰。

name: Nick Wilde - Providing Backup
en:
I'VE GOT THIS While you have another Detective
character in play, this character gains Support.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to
another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 交給我　當你另有一個偵探角色在場時，這個角色獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Judy Hopps - Always Vigilant
en:
Shift 2 ⬡ (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Judy Hopps.)
GOT YOU NOW When you play this character, if
you played another character this turn, you may
banish chosen character with 5 ¤ or more.
zh:
變身 2 ⬡（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Judy Hopps 的角色上。）
逮到你了　當你打出這個角色時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，你可以消滅一個 5 ¤ 或以上的指定角色。

name: Ancestral Guitar
en:
MUSICAL LEGACY When you play this item, draw a card.
FROM THE HEART ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Chosen character gains
Singer and counts as having +2 cost to sing songs
this turn.
zh:
音樂傳承　當你打出這個物品時，抽一張牌。
發自內心　⟳，1 ⬡ — 指定角色本回合獲得歌手，且詠唱歌曲時視為費用增加 2。

name: Dante - Enthusiastic Stray
en:
ANYTHING FOR YOU When you play this character,
chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 為你做任何事　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Archimedes - Messenger Owl
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
THE INDIGNITY! When this character is banished
in a challenge, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an
ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
豈有此理！　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Go Go Tomago - Extreme Tester
en:
GATHERING DATA Whenever this character is
challenged, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove an
ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 收集資料　每當這個角色被挑戰時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Belle - Reflective Writer
en:
CITY ADVENTURES When you play this character,
reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an item
card named Belle's City Guide or an action card,
you may put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it
on the bottom of your deck.
zh: 城市冒險　當你打出這個角色時，展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是名為 Belle's City Guide 的物品卡或行動卡，你可以將它加入手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

name: Baymax - Lab Assistant
en:
RESUPPLY When you play this character, if you
have 2 or more items in play, get 2 ink drops.
(Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh: 補充物資　當你打出這個角色時，若你在場有 2 個或以上的物品，獲得 2 個墨滴。（每個墨滴都可以移除來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Meilin Lee - Ecstatic Fan
en:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to
sing songs.)
SUPER STOKED Once during your turn, whenever
you play a song, get 1 ink drop. (You may remove
an ink drop to pay 1 ⬡.)
zh:
歌手 5（這個角色視為費用 5 來詠唱歌曲。）
超級興奮　你回合中一次，每當你打出一首歌時，獲得 1 個墨滴。（你可以移除一個墨滴來支付 1 ⬡。）

name: Héctor Rivera - Street Musician
en:
Singer 2 (This character counts as cost 2 to sing songs.)
STRIKE A CHORD When you play this character, you
may put the top card of your deck into your discard.
zh:
歌手 2（這個角色視為費用 2 來詠唱歌曲。）
撥動心弦　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡放入棄牌堆。

name: Though I Have to Say Goodbye
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Put the top 3 cards of your deck into your discard.
Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn for each song
card in your discard.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將你牌庫頂 3 張卡放入棄牌堆。你棄牌堆中每有一張歌曲卡，指定角色本回合就獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Daisy Duck - Savvy Investor
en:
SAVE FOR THE FUTURE When you play this character,
you may put a card from your hand into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
zh: 為未來儲蓄　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張手牌牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Wasabi - Future Thinker
en:
SAFETY FIRST When you play this character, if
you removed an ink drop to play him, your other
characters gain Resist +1 and Ward until the
start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 1. Opponents can't choose them except
to challenge.)
zh: 安全第一　當你打出這個角色時，若你移除過墨滴來打出他，你其他角色獲得抵抗 +1 和守護，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Priscilla - Efficient Clerk
en:
NOT-SO-SECRET CRUSH This character enters
play exerted.
FILING SYSTEM Whenever this character quests,
you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck.
Put one into your hand and the other into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
不太祕密的迷戀　這個角色橫置進場。
歸檔系統　每當這個角色探險時，你可以查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡。將一張加入手牌，另一張牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Tiana - Restauranteur
en:
HANDPICKED When you play this character, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
zh: 精心挑選　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Toulouse - Rough and Tumble
en:
UNBECOMING BEHAVIOR When you play this
character, opponents can't play actions until the
start of your next turn.
zh: 不得體的行為　當你打出這個角色時，對手不能打出行動，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Flash - Efficient Clerk
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
TAKE...YOUR...TIME All characters lose Rush
and can't gain Rush.
zh:
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）
慢……慢……來　所有角色失去突襲，且不能獲得突襲。

name: Aurora - Delightful Musician
en:
MELODIC REFRAIN When you play this character,
return a song card you played this turn with cost
3 or less from your discard to your hand.
JOYOUS RECEPTION At the end of your turn, if
you played a song this turn, gain 1 lore.
zh:
旋律重奏　當你打出這個角色時，將一張你本回合打出、費用 3 或以下的歌曲卡從棄牌堆移回手牌。
熱烈歡迎　在你的回合結束時，若你本回合打出過歌曲，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Miguel Rivera - Street Musician
en:
SHARE THE MUSIC While you have a song card
in your discard, this character gets +1 ◊ and
gains Singer 3.
zh: 分享音樂　當你的棄牌堆中有歌曲卡時，這個角色獲得 +1 ◊ 和歌手 3。

name: Remember Me
en:
Sing Together 6
For the rest of this turn, you may play characters
from your discard. If you do, they enter play exerted
and you can't play characters with the same name
as characters you played this way this turn.
zh:
合唱 6
本回合剩餘時間內，你可以從你的棄牌堆打出角色。若你這麼做，他們橫置進場，且本回合你不能打出與以此方式打出的角色同名的角色。

name: Rapunzel - Outgoing Artist
en:
PICTURE PERFECT Whenever this character
quests, you may choose another character
and reveal a character card in your hand. If
they have the same name, draw a card.
zh: 完美入畫　每當這個角色探險時，你可以選擇另一個角色並展示手牌中的一張角色卡。若兩者同名，抽一張牌。

name: Merlin - Profoundly Curious
en:
UNTAPPED POTENTIAL When you play this
character, get 1 ink drop.
THRILLING DISCOVERY Whenever this character
quests, draw a card.
zh:
未開發的潛能　當你打出這個角色時，獲得 1 個墨滴。
驚喜發現　每當這個角色探險時，抽一張牌。

name: Un Poco Loco
en:
Sing Together 3
Choose 2 characters of yours. If one of them is
cost 3 or less, return both to your hand.
zh:
合唱 3
選擇你 2 個角色。若其中一個費用為 3 或以下，將兩者都移回你的手牌。

name: Max Goof - Karaoke Star
en:
SWEET REMIX When you play this character, you
may choose and discard a song card. If you do,
draw 2 cards.
BRAND-NEW PLAYLIST While you have 5 or more
song cards in your discard, this character gets +3 ◊.
zh:
甜蜜混音　當你打出這個角色時，你可以選擇並棄掉一張歌曲卡。若你這麼做，抽 2 張牌。
全新歌單　當你的棄牌堆中有 5 張或以上的歌曲卡時，這個角色獲得 +3 ◊。

name: Belle - Exceptional Writer
en:
Shift 3 ⬡
HYPERIA CITY TIPS During your turn, whenever this
character exerts, you pay 2 ⬡ less for the next
action you play this turn.
HYPERIA CITY SECRETS During your turn, whenever
you play a third action, gain 3 lore.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡
Hyperia City 小撇步　在你的回合中，每當這個角色橫置時，你本回合打出的下一個行動少支付 2 ⬡。
Hyperia City 祕密　在你的回合中，每當你打出第三個行動時，獲得 3 點傳說值。

name: Shere Khan - Ruthless Entrepreneur
en:
QUIETLY RELEASED When you play this character,
put chosen opposing character with 3 ¤ or less
on the bottom of their player's deck.
zh: 悄悄解雇　當你打出這個角色時，將一個 3 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色放到其持有者的牌庫底。

name: Héctor Rivera - Worldwide Sensation
en:
Shift 4 ⬡
BIG HIT Whenever this character quests and
whenever he sings a song for the first time each
turn, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You
may reveal a song card and put it into your hand.
Put the rest into your discard.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
熱門金曲　每當這個角色探險，以及每回合他第一次詠唱歌曲時，查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。你可以展示一張歌曲卡並加入手牌。將其餘的放入你的棄牌堆。

name: Pepita - Imelda's Right Hand
en:
Shift 3 ⬡
ANCESTRAL WISDOM While you have 10 or
more cards in your discard, this character gets
+2 ¤ and +2 ◊.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡
先祖智慧　當你的棄牌堆中有 10 張或以上的卡時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤ 和 +2 ◊。

name: Mulan - Martial Arts Master
en:
WAY OF THE HERO When you play this character,
chosen character gets +2 ¤ and gains
“Whenever this character challenges another
character, draw a card” this turn.
WARRIOR SPIRIT Whenever this character quests,
chosen character gains Rush this turn.
zh:
英雄之道　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤，並獲得「每當這個角色挑戰另一個角色時，抽一張牌」。
戰士精神　每當這個角色探險時，指定角色本回合獲得突襲。

name: Thomas O'Malley - Savvy Vagabond
en:
LUCKY BREAK Whenever this character quests,
each player reveals the top card of their deck.
Put the card with the highest cost revealed this
way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its
player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
their players' decks.
zh: 意外好運　每當這個角色探險時，每位玩家展示其牌庫頂的卡。將以此方式展示、費用最高的卡，或並列費用最高的每張卡，加入其持有者的手牌。將其餘的放到其持有者的牌庫底。

name: Ariel - Collector of Oddities
en:
ONE OF A KIND Whenever you play an item, if
the item you played has a different name than
each other item you have in play, draw a card.
PERSONAL COLLECTION For each item with a
different name you have in play, this character
gets +1 ◊.
zh:
獨一無二　每當你打出一個物品時，若該物品與你在場的每個其他物品名稱都不同，抽一張牌。
私人收藏　你在場每有一個名稱不同的物品，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Baymax - Amped Up
en:
Shift Remove 2 ink drops
SUPERCHARGE If you would get an ink drop,
you may put the top card of your deck into
your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.
zh:
變身—移除 2 個墨滴
超級充能　若你將獲得一個墨滴，你可以改為將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Marie - Caught in the Act
zh: 小小獎勵　每當這個角色探險時，若有對方角色本回合受到過傷害，獲得 1 個墨滴。

name: Tiana - Party Hostess
en:
Shift 5 ⬡
IDEAL VENUE When you play this character, you
may draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a
card. If you discarded a location card this way,
you may play it from your discard for free.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
理想場地　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽 2 張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。若你以此方式棄掉地點卡，你可以從棄牌堆免費打出它。

name: Raya - Determined Explorer
en:
TO THE ENDS OF THE REALM This character
gets +1 ◊ for each location you have in play.
zh: 直到王國盡頭　你每有一個地點在場，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Mickey Mouse - Best in Town
en:
Adventurous
HOT DOG! At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, each player gets 1 ink drop.
zh:
冒險
好耶！　在你的回合結束時，若這個角色已橫置，每位玩家獲得 1 個墨滴。

name: Cinderella - Unintentional Icon
en:
Shift 5 ⬡
BESPOKE DESIGN At the end of your turn, you
may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one
on either the top or the bottom of your deck and
the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
量身設計　在你的回合結束時，你可以查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡。將一張放到牌庫頂或牌庫底，另一張牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。
